data.title: 若叶睦 · 菜畦的小木牌
data.description: 她把写好名字的小木牌插进土里，调整到不会挡住叶子的位置。做完后，她退开一步看了看。
data.promptProse: Kneeling beside a garden bed in a sunny greenhouse, Mutsumi gently presses a small carved wooden plant stake into the rich black soil near a tender sprout. Rows of terracotta pots and misty glass panels catch sunbeams filtering through the greenhouse roof.
data.animaCaption: Firming the soil around the wooden plant marker with her fingertips, she steps back to ensure the label stands upright.
